## Problem and outcome

Describe the concrete change and why it is needed.

## YouTrack issue

Link the real SASTT issue and explain which acceptance criteria this change addresses. Add this PR link to the same YouTrack issue.

## Validation

Describe checks actually performed, their results and remaining limitations. For research, cite the primary sources checked. For UI changes, include screenshots with synthetic or anonymized data.

## Review

Request review from another teammate. Record and address substantive feedback before merge; an assigned reviewer alone is not approval. Describe assistant help accurately and distinguish technical checks from independent student review.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full workflow.
